name: commerce/recently-viewed
title: Recently viewed
description: Products this visitor recently explored, in newest-first order.

ai.useFor: Help a visitor return to products they explored on this website. History comes from the current visitor session, never authored product IDs.
ai.avoid: Do not invent records, permissions, prices, endorsements or resource identifiers. Presentation comes from the selected template.

examples.title: The objects that caught your eye, ready for a second look and a little more consideration.
